semantic_findings: models.yaml declares one DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B-Abliterated Q6_K model as a single RLM serving chat, code, reason, audit and entity roles with max_ctx 4096 and an 8 GB RAM estimate.

This is a topology/policy snapshot, not artifact identity: it gives a filename and logical role set but no expected digest, source URI, tokenizer identity, runtime build identity or calibration/evaluation epoch.

Chronology matters: this file is dated earlier than the Docker model/bootstrap lineage, which later expects separate Llama 3.1 8B and Qwen 2.5 3B required files while treating DeepSeek as optional reasoning. The two configurations must not be merged into one static architecture claim.

The indexed repository search surfaced no additional consumers of this config at the frozen head, so current Level-0 treatment is LEGACY_OR_POSSIBLY_ORPHANED_MODEL_TOPOLOGY_SNAPSHOT pending history-aware reconciliation.
